financial_base.normalization_note: GAAP diluted EPS FY2025 was $4.73 on net income attributable of $10,053M, but that net income includes a $4,346M income-tax benefit (provision was a benefit of -$4,346M) and pre-tax income of $5,800M. The tax benefit is non-recurring, so GAAP EPS is not representative of earning power. Normalized basis: pre-tax income $5,800M (10-K) at an assumed ~23% normalized effective tax rate = ~$4,466M normalized net income; divided by ~2,125M diluted weighted-average shares (derived as $10,053M net income / $4.73 diluted EPS) = ~$2.10 per share. The 23% tax rate is an assumption, not a filing figure; at 20-25% the normalized EPS is ~$2.02-2.18. Current price $64.70 implies ~31x this normalized EPS (vs ~13.7x on reported GAAP $4.73, which is misleading). Uber pays no dividend (yield N/A).
